change: Selectable clockwise fan-out and shutter wheel effects
behavior: Fan out opens segments clockwise with an overlapping wave over 420 ms and reverses over 260 ms. Shutter opens all segments together with outward-growing, untwisting blades over 360 ms and closes over 240 ms. The effect is saved under Preferences > Keyboard > Neovim shortcuts > Opening effect. Fixed input geometry remains immediately interactive on entry; stale commands are blocked during exit. Grid behavior is unchanged.
validation_notes: Six JVM tests and nineteen Android UI checks passed. Inspected frozen mid-opening captures for both effects. No new whole-frame performance trace was recorded.
